name: BLAZBLUE CHRONOPHANTASMA
source:
The game takes place after the events of BlazBlue: Continuum Shift. The Story Mode has three scenarios: Chronophantasma, Sector Seven and Six Heroes. 

January, 2200AD 
It's been over one week since the loop came to an end. 
Having destroyed the Cauldrons, Ragna had finished his quest.

However... 
There was still unfinished business in his books. 
To defeat his now-revived nemesis, Terumi.
Terumi abducts the Successor of the Azure, Noel, and forces the Master Unit, Amaterasu to appear in the human plane. 
Hatred and vengeance awaken the Sword of the Godslayer, Kusanagi (Mu -No.12-).

Ragna sacrifices his own flesh and blood to save Noel, but even that Terumi had predicted. 
In a small window of opportunity, Terumi nullifies Takamagahara.

It was all a part of their— 
The NOL's highest commanding leader, the Imperator's will. 
Later, Kokonoe restores Ragna's flesh... 
...and he sets his course for the Federation's Hierarchical City: Ikaruga.
Little did he know, he would encounter the phantoms of time, the Chronophantasma, at his destination.

[From [url=http://blazblue.wikia.com/wiki/BlazBlue:_Chronophantasma]Blazblue Wiki[/url]]
translation:
本作的故事发生在《苍翼默示录：刻之幻影》之前作《苍翼默示录：连续变幻》的事件之后。故事模式包含三个篇章：刻之幻影、第七机关与六英雄。

公元2200年1月
循环结束已经过去一个多星期。
摧毁了锅炉后，拉格纳完成了自己的使命。

然而……
他的账本上仍有未完成的事项。
那就是击败如今复活的宿敌，照世。
照世绑架了苍之继承者诺爱尔，并迫使统御机关天照出现在人界。
仇恨与复仇唤醒了弑神之剑草薙（μ-12号）。

拉格纳牺牲自己的血肉来拯救诺爱尔，但这一切也在照世的预料之中。
照世抓住短暂的机会，使高天原失效。

这一切都是他们——
NOL最高指挥官帝卡的意志的一部分。
后来，九重恢复了拉格纳的肉身……
……而他则启程前往联邦的阶层都市斑鸠。
拉格纳并不知道，等待他的将是时间的幻影——刻之幻影。

[译自[url=http://blazblue.wikia.com/wiki/BlazBlue:_Chronophantasma]Blazblue Wiki[/url]]
